description: Stablecoin supply and transfer flow per chain and coin over a window. Mints and burns of 10,000 USD or more: counts, total dollars, large events, net of mints minus burns. Coins recorded since 2026-09-30T03:30Z: ethereum USDT, USDC, USD1, USDS; bnb USDT, USDC, USD1, U; polygon USDT, USDC, USDC.e; avalanche USDT, USDC; solana USDC, USDT; tron USDT. DAI is recorded as USDS, its new name; USDS on avalanche and solana is answered from recordedSince on its rows. DAI and PYUSD rows end 2026-09-30T03:30Z (recordedUntil on their rows); PYUSD is not recorded. Every recorded coin is answered, with zeros when it had no mint or burn; each row gives recordedSince and windowBeforeRecording, true when the window starts before the coin was recorded. supplyCheck: on EVM chains the token totalSupply is read every minute and compared with the events seen (checks, matched, missed). frozenDestroyed: USDT frozen funds destroyed by Tether (DestroyedBlackFunds) on ethereum and tron, counted from recordedSince (when the count started) by whole UTC day; null before the count started. transfers: on ethereum, bnb, polygon and avalanche, every transfer of more than 0 between two addresses (mints, burns and transfers of 0 left out) of the analysed blocks: count, dollars, five size bands, transfers of 500,000 USD or more with those touching a known exchange address and the five largest, and the blocks seen against the block span (coverage). window in hours, default 24, max 720. Omit chain for all six chains. Price: 2 cents per call.

chain.description: Chain name, one of the listed values; absent = every listed chain. Example: ethereum

window.description: Window in whole hours, 1 to 720, default 24. Example: 72

name: stablecoin_flows

dataGaps.description: Present only when the window of the answer overlaps a recorded data gap. Figures inside each listed period are incomplete. periods are the recorded gaps (end null while still open); atCall is measured against the window of this call and is left out of meta.contentHash.
